Situation report — last 30 minutes

  • פרוקסים אזוריים: ממשלת תימן מאשימה את משמרות המהפכה והחיזבאללה בשליחת 21 מומחים לתמיכה בחות'ים.

  • קו תחתון — מגמת איום: עולה. דיווחים על תקיפות וכוונות תקיפה של סנטקום מצביעים על סיכון הסלמה מיידי.

Situation Report (latest 2 hours)

  • Active strikes reported: U.S. strikes on Iran reported at 19:15 UTC.
  • CENTCOM strike planning: CENTCOM reportedly holds plans for a military operation against Iran as early as Wednesday; final decision rests with the U.S. president.
  • Chemical-weapons warning: Israel has shared intelligence with the U.S. saying Iran is considering use of chemical weapons.
  • Air defenses moving to south Israel: Accelerated transfers of air-defense systems to southern Israel continue from U.S. bases in Texas and Germany.
  • U.S. political move: Reports say President Trump announced an end to U.S. military aid to Israel; Israeli finance ministry says no formal document has been submitted.
  • Diplomacy: Iran rejects reports of a preliminary agreement with the U.S.; indirect negotiations continue, per Tehran.
  • Regional proxies: Yemen government accuses IRGC and Hezbollah of sending 21 experts to support the Houthis.

Bottom line

  • Threat trend: Escalating — active U.S. strikes reported, CENTCOM has strike plans, and Iran is flagged as considering chemical weapons.
  • 🟢 Good News: Continued accelerated delivery of air-defense systems to southern Israel.

Situation report

Active strikes: U.S. launched strikes on Iran (reported).
  • Chemical-weapons warning: Israel shared intelligence with the U.S. reporting Iran is considering use of chemical weapons against Tel Aviv.
  • Air defenses: Accelerated transfer of air-defense systems to southern Israel from U.S. bases in Texas and from bases in Germany.
  • US–Israel aid & diplomacy: President Trump announced end to U.S. military aid to Israel (reported $4B annually, to end by end of 2026). Israeli finance ministry says no formal document was submitted. Iran says indirect negotiations continue and denies reports of a preliminary agreement.
  • Iranian operations: IRGC released footage claiming it shot down a U.S. MQ-9 drone in the Strait of Hormuz. Yemen government accuses IRGC and Hezbollah of sending 21 experts to back the Houthis.
  • Domestic (Israel): Israeli forces detained an Al Jazeera journalist during Hebron raids (reported).
  • Threat trend: Escalating — current reports show active U.S. strikes, an Iranian shootdown of a U.S. drone, chemical-weapons considerations, and regional force movements.
  • 🟢 Good News: Additional air-defense systems are being moved into southern Israel.

Situation Report — last 48 hours

Active strikes: U.S. launched strikes on Iran (multiple reports today).

  • Strikes & military actions

    • U.S. struck targets in Iran, reported today.
    • CENTCOM had plans for a possible operation as early as tomorrow, per reporting.
    • IRGC released footage claiming it shot down a U.S. MQ-9 drone in the Strait of Hormuz.
    • Yemen government accuses IRGC and Hezbollah of sending 21 experts to support the Houthis.

    • Israel shared intelligence with the U.S. saying Iran is considering use of chemical weapons against its adversaries.
    • Iran says indirect negotiations with the U.S. continue and rejects reports of a preliminary agreement.
    • Iran’s president stated publicly that assassination attempts would not deter the country’s stance.

  • Deployments & defenses

    • U.S. is accelerating transfers of air‑defense systems to southern Israel from bases in Texas and Germany.

  • Diplomacy & aid

    • U.S. President announced ending $4 billion annual military aid to Israel by end of 2026.
    • Israeli finance ministry says no formal document was submitted by the U.S. regarding termination of aid.

  • Domestic & media

    • Israel detained an Al Jazeera journalist during raids in Hebron.
    • Reports note a political deadlock in Israel affecting the prime minister’s future.
  • Threat trend: Escalating.
  • 🟢 Good News: Accelerated transfer of air‑defense systems to southern Israel continues.
